Velocity X9 vs Marathon Elite: which should you buy?

Buy the Velocity X9 (₹5,499) if you want one shoe for most of your running. Buy the Marathon Elite (₹8,999) only if you race and already have a daily trainer. Both are in stock today.

Velocity X9 compared with Marathon Elite

The Marathon Elite is 47 grams lighter and noticeably stiffer, which helps at half marathon pace and above. It also wears out roughly twice as fast, so the cost per kilometre is about four times higher.
